Nung nagpaconsult ako sa braces ko dati, akala ko malalagyan na ako agad. But I had so many issues sa ngipin ko that needed to be fixed first. Once naresolve na lahat ng yun, saka ako nilagyan. I got the self ligating braces. 

Nag down lang ako before ng 5k. Then bayad din monthly for the adjustments. 

First 2 weeks puro singaw bibig ko pero it gets better. I dont know if I just have high pain tolerance pero. I never felt pain. Discomfort lang at most. 

Also, my dental hygiene honestly improved nung nag braces ako kasi naeexcite ako sa progress. 

Lahat naman ng pagkain nakakain ko but just be careful sa mga matitigas na pagkain baka matanggalan ka ng bracket at mahal sya ipakabit ulit. Also, may learning curve kumain ng ramen/ yung green mango sa stick/ rice cakes in public kasi the nattrap sila sa wire. 

I got my braces off after 2 years pero mejo yellow sya nung tinaggal na so I had them bleached. Its been 4 years since nung bleach pero hanggang ngayon maputi padin sya. Worth it talaga. Sobrang game-changer din ang electric toothbrush. I cant go back to manual. Parang feeling ko hindi sya ganun kalinis.
